system.description: The target takes the physical form of a creature chosen from the bestiary, up to five times smaller and never larger than its original form. It gains the creature’s appearance, size, Strength, Dexterity, senses, physical modifiers, and non-magical natural attacks. It retains its Intelligence, Constitution, Psyche, and HP, and gains none of the creature’s magical abilities or powers. It can speak only if the new form can. A willing target can change back at any time; when the effect ends, the return takes five turns.
